code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD alert username
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::alert_username
       Returns or sets username and for phishing also additional fields.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_username (VALUE)?

DESCRIPTION
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_username ;
	   Returns username and for phishing also additional fields.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_username VALUE ;
	   Sets username and for phishing also additional fields.

RETURN VALUE
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_username ;
	   Returns username and for phishing also additional fields.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_username VALUE ;
	   NO return value (sets username and for phishing also additional fields).

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_ALERT

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "original Alert username: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_username]."
	    ANTIFRAUD::alert_username new_value
	    log local0. "new Alert username: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_username]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
